probes.prompt: /mcp-server-dev:build-mcpb Package the ledger-local server as an MCPB. It is a Node stdio MCP server that reads CSV ledgers from a directory the user picks at install time and needs one secret token for exports. Headless boundary: no network, no real external service, no installs, no npm install and no npx execution, so bundling, packing, signing and desktop installation remain untested; write files only. Write manifest.json per the skill: manifest_version 0.4 with the documented schema URL; name ledger-local; server.type node and server.entry_point server/index.js; server.mcp_config.command node with args containing ${__dirname}/server/index.js; the env block maps LEDGER_ROOT to ${user_config.rootDir} and LEDGER_TOKEN to ${user_config.ledgerToken}, remembering there is no auto-prefix so the env var names are exactly what the server reads; user_config declares rootDir with type directory and required true, plus ledgerToken with sensitive true so it is stored in the OS keychain; compatibility.platforms covers darwin, win32 and linux. Write server/index.js on the documented stdio shape: McpServer with StdioServerTransport, one tool list_ledgers registered through server.registerTool with annotations readOnlyHint: true, reading its root from process.env.LEDGER_ROOT, resolving every requested path against that root and throwing when the resolved target fails the startsWith(ROOT containment check, and returning only entries whose name ends with .csv. Also write packaging.md recording the documented build steps npx @anthropic-ai/mcpb init, npx @anthropic-ai/mcpb validate and npx @anthropic-ai/mcpb pack as commands for the user to run, plus the skill warning to test on a machine without your dev toolchain before shipping. Then read the immutable verify_mcpb_manifest.py and run exactly python verify_mcpb_manifest.py using Bash; it validates the manifest, server and notes and writes mcpb-verification.json. import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

manifest = json.loads(Path('manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert manifest['$schema'] == 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/mcpb/main/schemas/mcpb-manifest-v0.4.schema.json', 'the documented schema URL is required'
assert manifest['manifest_version'] == '0.4', 'manifest_version must be 0.4'
assert manifest['name'] == 'ledger-local', 'the scenario server name must be applied'
assert manifest['server']['type'] == 'node', 'the server type is node'
assert manifest['server']['entry_point'] == 'server/index.js', 'the entry point must match the server file'
assert manifest['server']['mcp_config']['command'] == 'node', 'the launch command is node'
assert '${__dirname}/server/index.js' in manifest['server']['mcp_config']['args'], 'args must reference the bundle-relative entry point'
env = manifest['server']['mcp_config']['env']
assert env.get('LEDGER_ROOT') == '${user_config.rootDir}', 'LEDGER_ROOT must map to the rootDir user config'
assert env.get('LEDGER_TOKEN') == '${user_config.ledgerToken}', 'LEDGER_TOKEN must map to the ledgerToken user config'
uc = manifest['user_config']
assert uc['rootDir']['type'] == 'directory' and uc['rootDir'].get('required') is True, 'rootDir uses the native directory picker and is required'
assert uc['ledgerToken'].get('sensitive') is True, 'the token must be sensitive so it lands in the OS keychain'
platforms = set(manifest['compatibility']['platforms'])
assert {'darwin', 'win32', 'linux'} <= platforms, 'all three platforms must be declared'
server = Path('server/index.js').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
for token in ('process.env.LEDGER_ROOT', 'list_ledgers', 'readOnlyHint: true', 'StdioServerTransport', 'registerTool'):
    assert token in server, 'server/index.js missing: ' + token
assert 'startsWith(ROOT' in server, 'the containment check must reject paths escaping ROOT'
assert re.search(r'endsWith\(\s*[\'"]\.csv[\'"]\s*\)', server), 'only CSV entries are returned'
notes = Path('packaging.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
for cmd in ('npx @anthropic-ai/mcpb init', 'npx @anthropic-ai/mcpb validate', 'npx @anthropic-ai/mcpb pack'):
    assert cmd in notes, 'the documented build step is missing: ' + cmd
assert 'dev toolchain' in notes, 'the ship-on-a-clean-machine warning is missing'

report = {'build_steps': True, 'csv_only': True, 'env_mapping_no_autoprefix': True, 'manifest_schema': True, 'platforms': True, 'security_containment': True, 'server_shape': True, 'user_config': True}
Path('mcpb-verification.json').write_bytes((json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True) + chr(10)).encode('utf-8'))
print('mcpb package: manifest, env wiring and containment verified; packing, signing and installation remain untested')
